reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Frederick C. Atkinson: public domain needs a death year before 1955 (or "traditional": true for an anonymous source). Imported from CCEH tune 000132 (the melody read from 000132a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000132a.nwc). The tune ends on G, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
